high_level_description: The image shows a person taking a mirror selfie. The individual is wearing a white button-up shirt and camouflage-patterned shorts. They have a black wristwatch on their left wrist and are holding a smartphone with both hands, which appears to be capturing the photo. The person is indoors, standing in front of a mirror that reflects part of the room behind them. The background includes a window with horizontal blinds partially open, allowing some light to filter through. The lighting in the room is warm, creating a soft glow on the person's face and clothing.
